meta.name: deeptools
meta.description: NGS analysis toolkit. BAM to bigWig conversion, QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprints), heatmaps/profiles (TSS, peaks), for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq visualization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析测序数据,产出质控报告与信号图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果做基因组测序研究,需要把比对数据转成可视化结果。
copy.tagline_en: Turn sequencing data into QC charts and genome-wide signal maps.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study genomes and need to visualize sequencing data for QC.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会调用 deepTools 命令行工具处理测序数据:BAM 转 bigWig、质控(相关性、PCA、指纹)、TSS/峰区热图与曲线,并生成 ChIP-seq 等分析脚本。
howto.when: 当你要求把 BAM 转成 bigWig、做质控或画 TSS 热图等 NGS 数据处理时,它会接管并给出命令。

say.text: 把我的 ChIP.bam 转成 bigWig,用 RPGC 归一化
say.note: 调用 bamCoverage 生成覆盖度轨道

say.text: 帮我检查这个 ChIP-seq 样本的富集质量
say.note: 运行 plotFingerprint 画指纹图

say.text: 在 TSS 附近画一张信号热图

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs deepTools command-line tools: BAM to bigWig coverage tracks, QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprint), heatmaps/profiles at TSS and peaks, and workflow scripts for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq.
howto.when_en: Use it when you ask to convert BAM to bigWig, run QC, or plot a heatmap at TSS, or when analyzing ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq data.

say_en.text: Convert my ChIP.bam to bigWig with RPGC normalization
say_en.note: Runs bamCoverage to make a coverage track

say_en.text: Check the enrichment quality of this ChIP-seq sample
Plot a signal heatmap around TSS
